chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman with her hair in a high bun with a pink scrunchie, wearing a loose lavender oversized sweatshirt and loose grey sweatpants
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her 40s wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a beige headscarf
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man in his 50s with a grey mustache and glasses, wearing a navy blazer over a blue checked shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: seen from the bedroom doorway: GIRL in her bedroom stands in front of a phone on a tripod with a ring light, doing a TikTok live, she freezes mid-move and turns her head toward the door in panic, eyes wide, head-to-waist framing

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: the front door of a Moroccan apartment opens, MOM and DAD walk in carrying shopping bags, smiling, coming home

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: a Moroccan living room with a traditional sedari sofa, GIRL sits with MOM and DAD forcing a fake innocent smile, her phone lying face down on the sofa next to her, the parents drink tea relaxed

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: close-up of GIRL sitting on the sofa, sweating nervously, eyes glancing sideways at her face-down phone, torn and anxious

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: an imagined scene: DAD sits in an armchair looking at his smartphone with a shocked, angry face, his tea glass frozen in his hand

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: GIRL rushes back into her bedroom, closes the door behind her and grabs her phone from the desk, biting her lip

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits on her bed staring at her phone with her jaw dropped in shock and joy, hand over her mouth, glowing light from the phone screen on her face, a small pile of banknotes floating around her as a dreamy effect

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: two days later, GIRL in her bedroom happily starts another live on the phone on the tripod with the ring light, waving at the camera with a big confident smile

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: at the family dinner table, DAD holds out some banknotes to GIRL, she politely refuses with a raised hand and a calm smile, MOM and DAD exchange a puzzled suspicious look
